item.title: ShikataLab - Letting an AI Agent Run My Homelab While I Travel
item.description: I’m in Korea for a couple of weeks, and I figured it was a good excuse to finally polish up the homelab back in Toronto. The catch: you can’t exactly do homelab work from a hotel room in Seoul. So most of the actual work has been done by an AI agent — Meta’s Muse, which I’ve taken to calling Jett. I send it messages from my phone between meals, it does the work, I review the diffs.
